_contract: Karos landing-engine brand contract v1 (generalized). FIXTURE — a fabricated fitness client used to build/prove the engine against a non-fintech brand. Not a real client; lives in engine/fixtures, never in clients/.

identity.sector: strength & conditioning training app (iOS / Android / web)
identity.audience: serious amateur lifters, 25-40, train 4-6x/week, track their numbers
identity.positioning: train like an athlete, not a tourist - adaptive programming + real progress tracking + coaching
identity.personality: confident coach: direct, evidence-led, motivating without cheese
identity.mood: bold / dark / high-energy (drives a stronger motion intensity than a calm brand)

tokens.ground: ink (dark mode IS the brand - opposite of a cream/light-ground brand)

fonts.display: Clash Display (heavy grotesque, headlines + big numbers)
fonts.rule: max 2 type families in active use; mono for numbers/labels only

brandLaw: Second person, present tense. Talk to the lifter: 'you train', 'your numbers'. Never corporate third person.
Evidence and programming lead. NO scammy hype ('transform your body in 7 days', 'secret', 'hack').
Real numbers are heroes - volume, PRs, weeks. Frame honestly (median user, not 'guaranteed').
Ember (orange) is accent only (~8%): CTAs, key numbers, active states. Never large ember fields.
Dark ground always. Bone type on ink. AA contrast on every text surface.
en-US copy. Confident, plain, athletic. Motivating, not motivational-poster.

voice.lead: what you get stronger at + how the programming adapts to you

oldSite.look: 2019 SaaS template: full-bleed stock-video hero of someone lifting, system-font headings, corporate blue accent (#2D7FF9), 3-up FEATURES icon grid, a Free/Pro/Elite pricing table, a testimonials carousel, app-store badge row. Generic, dated, no motion, no identity.

carryForward.what: Progress-tracking chart - weekly training volume / estimated-1RM trend over time
carryForward.note: VALUABLE. Re-apply as the signatureShowcase set-piece, restyled to ink/bone/ember. Animate the line drawing on scroll.

carryForward.what: Coaching assistant ('Coach') - answers programming/form questions, bottom-right launcher
carryForward.note: Preserve. Restyle launcher + panel to new brand. Keep its entry point; do not lose this capability.

content.note: Engine writes the copy from these facts, obeying brandLaw + voice.
